title: Add polli-agent — a multimodal router app
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
Adds `apps/polli-agent`, a sibling to `apps/polli`.

Where `polli` is the Discord/GitHub assistant, `polli-agent` is the router: you give it one prompt and it handles the rest — picks the model, decides whether the answer is text, an image, audio, a video, or several of those at once, and returns them in a single response.

It's an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint (SSE streaming) backed by a tool-calling loop that generates and edits images, renders and stitches video (including start/end-frame interpolation), synthesises and transcribes speech, searches the web, and runs a sandboxed shell with ffmpeg — chaining them freely. Pass a Pollinations key per request via `Authorization: Bearer`, or set `OPENAI_API_KEY` for local use.

FastAPI + pydantic-settings; tests and a Dockerfile are included. README has the full rundown.

gist.headline: One prompt, many petals
gist.blurb: Meet polli-agent: hand it a prompt and it figures out which Pollinations tools should bloom. Text, images, audio, video, web search, and a little ffmpeg alchemy can now travel together in one response.
gist.summary: Added apps/polli-agent, an OpenAI-compatible streaming /v1/chat/completions router that uses a tool-calling loop to select and chain text, image generation/editing, speech synthesis/transcription, video rendering and stitching, web search, and sandboxed ffmpeg tools.
gist.impact: Developers can send one authenticated prompt to polli-agent and receive coordinated multimodal text, image, audio, video, or combined results without manually orchestrating the underlying tools.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a cozy conductor in a garden workshop, routing one glowing prompt-seed through branching vines into a retro terminal, a picture frame, a speaker, and a tiny film projector. The monitor robot eagerly observes the different outputs while code-plants visually connect the tools, representing the agent freely chaining media capabilities into one answer.
